caption: annular solar eclipse in aquarius tomorrow, 15:59 utc. never look at the sun without eclipse glasses.

slides.headline: a ring of fire *eclipse* in aquarius, tomorrow
annular means the moon is too small to cover the *sun*
slides.body: the new moon passes in front of the sun but sits far enough away that a bright ring stays. greatest eclipse is over the south atlantic. only a narrow path sees the ring.

slides.headline: “eclipses are bad luck”
slides.body: an eclipse is the moon and sun lining up, nothing more. astrologers read eclipses as fast-forward buttons: things that were already ending end, things already starting start.

rows.label: aquarius
rows.text: it's in your sign. a reset on how you show up.

rows.label: leo
rows.text: the opposite sign. partners say the quiet part.

rows.label: scorpio
rows.text: home and work trade places for a bit.

slides.headline: tonight: write down one thing to *start*
slides.body: eclipse glasses only. save this for tomorrow.
